invariants.rationale: instantTime must be a valid non-empty string representing the commit instant time.

meta.value: instantTime is a non-null non-empty string representing the commit time.

invariants.rationale: partitionPath must be non-null to represent the partition location.

meta.value: partitionPath represents the partition directory path and should not be null.

invariants.rationale: fileId must be a non-null and non-empty string.

meta.value: fileId is the file identifier and must be non-null and non-empty.

invariants.rationale: keyToNewRecords must be non-null to support record updates.

meta.value: keyToNewRecords maps keys to records and must be initialized before processing.

invariants.rationale: dataFileToBeMerged must be non-null to perform the merge.

meta.value: dataFileToBeMerged represents the existing file to merge and should not be null.
